user.title: Set up HA Doctor
user.description: Scan this Home Assistant for persistent outages and missing entity references. Findings appear under Settings → System → Repairs. You decide what to change.

abort.already_configured: HA Doctor is already set up.

unavailable.title: {entity} has been unavailable for at least {minutes} minutes
unavailable.description: Home Assistant has lost contact with `{entity}`. Open its device page to see whether other entities on the same device are affected. Check the device's power, connection, and integration status. A sleeping or intentionally disconnected device may be expected.

missing.title: {source} refers to a missing entity
missing.description: Home Assistant cannot find `{target}`, which is referenced by `{source}`. Open the automation or script and look for this entity ID. Check whether the target was renamed, removed, or has yet to load before selecting a replacement.
